query:
insert into UnknownRequirements (
                agg_collect_nr,
                req_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                req_id
            )
            select
                rs.agg_collect_nr,
                rs.req_collect_nr,
                rs.product_id,
                rs.req_id
            from RequirementVerificationStates rs
            where rs.agg_collect_nr = $1
            and rs.state == $2
